title: the poster answers first, report misuse is tracked, and the platform holds steady Tuesday to Thursday

criteria.text: When content hides, the poster is told the category and the reporter's reason and gets one answer
criteria.note: `member_notices` row on the hide; `YouNotices` on `/you` (#506, #706); the words and item kinds have their own notice text (#820, #920) [V] Checked: `[guards F102.1]` in `f102-criteria.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `you` green 2026-10-23 (cb892a7) [A]

criteria.text: Fix and repost: the edit shows again at once, reports stay on the row, no second repost, not offered for severity 1
criteria.note: `page_posts.repost_used`; severity 1 never reposts (#506, #773); an owner's edit of hidden Page words or an item clears that hide too (#820, #920) [V] Checked: `[guards F102.2]` in `tests/f102-fix-and-repost-db.test.ts` [V] Reviewed: #773 `review-skipped` [V]

criteria.text: The poster can say the report is wrong: one answer per hide, it goes to the AI pass and the row, the content stays hidden
criteria.note: `report_answers` unique per notice; the rebuttal reaches `run-assessment`; one "This is a mistake" button (#506, #513, #706) [V] Checked: `[guards F102.3]` in `tests/f102-answer-db.test.ts:76` through the real action against the local database, seen failing against four mutants (#912, closed #838) [V] Reviewed: #706 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `you` green 2026-10-23 [A]

criteria.text: The answer is one of Mistaken, Malicious or Misusing reports, plus a 280-character note
criteria.note: RETIRED. Overtaken by the PM's copy call of 2026-10-11 on #627 and #626 ("one button only; remove the three answer choices"); F102 `## Rulings` still has no dated line for it and criterion 3 still lists the three answers, so `sync-roadmap` should record it and amend the scenario [V].

criteria.text: No answer is no work: an unanswered hide stays hidden and closes after 14 days; the batch shows it only if severity 1
criteria.note: `ANSWER_WINDOW_DAYS = 14`; a lapsed hide leaves the batch unless severity 1 (#773) [V] Checked: `[guards F102.4]` in `ReviewQueue.test.tsx`; its clock is pinned since #900, after the fixtures crossed the 14-day window on 17 Oct and went red [V] Reviewed: #773 `review-skipped` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-22 (e0bdaf1) [V]

criteria.text: Per-reporter counters (filed, upheld, dismissed, open); operator-only; used by nothing outside the report path
criteria.note: Counters in `reports-queue.ts`, shown on the row (#506); the "never a score on a person" comment was dropped after the 2026-10-16 ruling, the counters unchanged (#819) [V] Checked: `[guards F102.5]` in `f102-criteria.test.tsx` [V] Reviewed: #506 carries `Reviewed by:` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-22 [V]

criteria.text: The cap tightens: 5 hiding reports open at once, 1 after any dismissal in the last 30 days
Cool-down: two dismissals in 30 days start 14 days in which that reporter's reports hide nothing
criteria.note: SPEC-CONFLICT. Cool-down and three strikes are built (`create.ts`: `COOL_DOWN_DAYS = 14`), but urgent categories (sensitive content, threat of harm) still hide during one ("Ruled 2026-10-08, Dispatch" in the code) while the criterion says hide nothing; F102 `## Rulings` still carries no such line [V]. Test: `[guards F102.7]` in `create.test.ts:780` asserts the built reading.

criteria.text: Three or more reports in 24 hours, two from accounts under 7 days old, flag the row "Possible coordinated reporting" and lift it one tier
criteria.note: `coordinatedPosters` and the sort tier in `review-subjects.ts`; the flag in `ReviewQueue.tsx` (#506) [V] Checked: `[guards F102.8]` in `f102-whole-criteria.test.tsx:39`: both thresholds each side, the flag, the one-tier lift, seen failing against three mutants (#912) [V] Reviewed: #506 carries `Reviewed by:` [V] Smoked: `admin-reports` green 2026-10-22 [V]
